Animal welfare group urges food system transformation to fight AMR

World Animal Protection has called for urgent action to transform food systems and address antimicrobial resistance (AMR) by improving animal welfare. The organization emphasizes that better animal welfare practices are crucial in tackling the growing threat of AMR.
